images.caption: Figure 1.Overview of Fin-SD. The student is sampled on a training problem and judged against the ground truth. On failures, a frozen copy of the student receives the query, the failing trajectory, and the answer, and returns the first faulty stepkk, a short critiquehh, and an error type; pure arithmetic slips are dropped without a gradient. The trajectory is truncated immediatelybeforek, so both policies condition on the on-policy prefix before the localized error, with the frozen teacher also receivinghh. The student minimizes the per-token KL between the two next-token distributions over an L = 100 rollout. At each epoch boundary, the failure set is re-mined and the teacher re-frozen.
